integrity: The full open primary article was inspected through its class definition, exceptional-set-free local Wiman-Valiron estimate, asymptotic derivative theorem, discussion, and examples. The new conclusion follows by the exact natural rescaling, a compactness proof of stability of injectivity, and an explicit iterated-exponential collision. The sharpness example also satisfies the source regularity condition by a direct choice of delta(r), so no numerical experiment or unproved membership assertion is needed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a one-complex-dimensional directional-slice statement. It guarantees every fixed rescaled radius R<pi and proves that no fixed R>pi can hold uniformly, but it does not assert universal behavior at the exact open radius pi and does not claim multivariable injectivity of the ambient entire function.
title: A sharp microscopic univalence radius in exceptional-set-free Wiman–Valiron scaling
